name: Elevated Might (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): At least one racial Hit Die.

Benefit(s): Add your Hit Dice from class levels to any racial Hit Dice you possess for the purpose of determining the DCs of any abilities based on racial Hit Dice (such as breath weapons, frightful presence, etc.) and the DCs of abilities based on class level (such as channel energy).
